definitions.explanation: A plant used for its healing or therapeutic properties, either in traditional herbal medicine or modern pharmacology.

examples.english: Pick medicinal herbs in the mountains.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{薬草|やくそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{民間|みんかん}→民間：13260_minkan⟧⟦{療法|りょうほう}→療法：13615_ryouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝|つた}わっている→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。
examples.english: In this region, folk remedies using medicinal herbs have been passed down since long ago.

examples.japanese: {薬草|やくそう}{園|えん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、さまざまな⟦{薬効|やっこう}→薬効：21819_yakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I visited a medicinal herb garden and learned about plants with various therapeutic properties.

notes:
USAGE:
Japan has a long tradition of herbal medicine (⟦{漢方|かんぽう}→漢方：13397_kanpou⟧), and {薬草|やくそう} appears frequently in discussions of traditional medicine, health foods, and natural remedies. Also a common term in video games and fantasy settings where herbs are used for healing.

COMPOUNDS:
- {薬草|やくそう}⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧: herbal tea (medicinal)
- {薬草|やくそう}{園|えん}: medicinal herb garden
- {薬草|やくそう}{風呂|ぶろ}: herbal bath
